Our grader noise attenuates arm differences by 1-FN-FP = 0.237 (v3) / 0.231 (v4): a true 10pp gap appears as ~2.4pp; ~18x items needed to compensate.
3 checkpoints cannot support any arm ranking at any n: max 3 discordant pairs, exact McNemar minimum two-sided p = 0.25; reruns cluster the same 3 items.
Cheapest supportable design: 12 decidable checkpoints x 3 runs/arm = 36 paired items (108 extra requests), exact McNemar at alpha .05 on one pre-registered contrast, Wilson 95% CIs, pass^3.
p95 CI at n=48 spans the 8 largest observations; a 2x p95 decision rule needs n in the hundreds (192 = four 48-turn runs per arm).
